sections.instruction: Put the following sentences into the PASSIVE VOICE:

questions.prompt: Someone has already paid the electrician for his work.
acceptedAnswers: The electrician has already been paid for his work.

questions.prompt: They taught him French and gave him a dictionary.
acceptedAnswers: He was taught French and was given a dictionary.
He was taught French and given a dictionary.
French was taught to him and a dictionary was given to him.
questions.explanation: past simple passive with two objects

questions.prompt: When we first met, they had already offered me a job at the bank.
acceptedAnswers: When we first met, I had already been offered a job at the bank.
When we first met, a job at the bank had already been offered to me.

questions.prompt: A man requested the stranger to leave the meeting.
acceptedAnswers: The stranger was requested to leave the meeting.

sections.instruction: Read the following sentences and write another one with the same meaning (start with the subject of the that-clause):

questions.prompt: It is believed that the wanted man is living in New York.
acceptedAnswers: The wanted man is believed to be living in New York.

questions.prompt: It is said that many people are homeless after the floods.
acceptedAnswers: Many people are said to be homeless after the floods.

questions.prompt: It is expected that the government will lose this election.
acceptedAnswers: The government is expected to lose this election.

questions.prompt: It is known that the Prime Minister is in favour of the new law.
acceptedAnswers: The Prime Minister is known to be in favour of the new law.
The Prime Minister is known to be in favor of the new law.

questions.prompt: It is believed that the thieves got in through the kitchen window.
acceptedAnswers: The thieves are believed to have got in through the kitchen window.
The thieves are believed to have gotten in through the kitchen window.

questions.prompt: It is thought that the prisoner escaped by climbing over the wall.
acceptedAnswers: The prisoner is thought to have escaped by climbing over the wall.

questions.prompt: It is claimed that he drove through the town at 90 miles an hour.
acceptedAnswers: He is claimed to have driven through the town at 90 miles an hour.

questions.prompt: It is reported that two people were seriously injured in the accident.
acceptedAnswers: Two people are reported to have been seriously injured in the accident.
questions.explanation: earlier passive: to have been + V3

questions.prompt: It is said that three men were arrested after the explosion.
acceptedAnswers: Three men are said to have been arrested after the explosion.
questions.explanation: earlier passive: to have been + V3

questions.prompt: It is believed that Maria will not win the prize.
acceptedAnswers: Maria is believed not to win the prize.
Maria is not believed to win the prize.
Maria is believed not to be going to win the prize.

questions.prompt: It is considered that the 2008 Olympic Games will be held in Turkey.
acceptedAnswers: The 2008 Olympic Games are considered to be held in Turkey.
The 2008 Olympic Games is considered to be held in Turkey.
The 2008 Olympic Games are considered likely to be held in Turkey.
The 2008 Olympic Games is considered likely to be held in Turkey.

questions.prompt: It is said that our teacher is 55 years old.
acceptedAnswers: Our teacher is said to be 55 years old.

questions.prompt: It is thought that Tom didn’t steal their rings.
acceptedAnswers: Tom is thought not to have stolen their rings.
Tom is not thought to have stolen their rings.
questions.explanation: negative earlier action: not to have + V3

questions.prompt: It is claimed that this examination will be the most difficult one.
acceptedAnswers: This examination is claimed to be the most difficult one.

questions.prompt: It is believed that John will marry Ann at the end of this month.
acceptedAnswers: John is believed to marry Ann at the end of this month.
John is believed to be marrying Ann at the end of this month.
John is believed to be going to marry Ann at the end of this month.

questions.prompt: It is expected that people will live on Mars in 2050.
acceptedAnswers: People are expected to live on Mars in 2050.
People are expected to live in Mars in 2050.

sections.instruction: Change these sentences into PASSIVE FORM:

questions.prompt: People believe that the strike will end soon.
acceptedAnswers: It is believed that the strike will end soon.
It is believed the strike will end soon.
The strike is believed to end soon.
The strike is believed to be ending soon.
questions.explanation: It is believed that / subject + to-infinitive

questions.prompt: People believe that the thieves got through the kitchen window.
acceptedAnswers: It is believed that the thieves got through the kitchen window.
It is believed the thieves got through the kitchen window.
The thieves are believed to have got through the kitchen window.
The thieves are believed to have gotten through the kitchen window.

questions.prompt: People say that the company is losing a lot of money.
acceptedAnswers: It is said that the company is losing a lot of money.
It is said the company is losing a lot of money.
The company is said to be losing a lot of money.

questions.prompt: When is he going to pay the taxes?
acceptedAnswers: When are the taxes going to be paid?
When are the taxes going to be paid by him?
questions.explanation: be going to be + V3 question

questions.prompt: Who has designed these buildings?
acceptedAnswers: Who have these buildings been designed by?
By whom have these buildings been designed?

questions.prompt: How much do they spend on these activities?
acceptedAnswers: How much is spent on these activities?

questions.prompt: They broke a lot of plates while they were dancing.
acceptedAnswers: A lot of plates were broken while they were dancing.

questions.prompt: Who invented the electric bulb?
acceptedAnswers: Who was the electric bulb invented by?
By whom was the electric bulb invented?

questions.prompt: People believe that they are secret agents.
acceptedAnswers: It is believed that they are secret agents.
It is believed they are secret agents.
They are believed to be secret agents.
questions.explanation: It is believed that / to be

questions.prompt: People think that he takes harmful drugs.
acceptedAnswers: It is thought that he takes harmful drugs.
It is thought he takes harmful drugs.
He is thought to take harmful drugs.

questions.prompt: Did they give you a great reception?
acceptedAnswers: Were you given a great reception?
Was a great reception given to you?

questions.prompt: Nobody sends her a card at Christmas.
acceptedAnswers: She is not sent a card at Christmas.
She is not sent a card at Christmas by anybody.
She is not sent a card at Christmas by anyone.
She is sent no card at Christmas.
She is not sent a card by anybody at Christmas.
She is not sent a card by anyone at Christmas.

questions.prompt: Did anyone call an ambulance after the accident?
acceptedAnswers: Was an ambulance called after the accident?
Was an ambulance called after the accident by anyone?

questions.prompt: Will you pay the fine?
acceptedAnswers: Will the fine be paid?
Will the fine be paid by you?

acceptedAnswers: are examined / brought|are brought

questions.prompt: I’m lucky because I [gap] (never / take) to hospital.
acceptedAnswers: have never been taken

questions.prompt: My sister was taken to hospital when she [gap] (hit) by a car last month.
acceptedAnswers: was hit

questions.prompt: Luckily no bones [gap] (break) but she [gap] (examine) carefully and x-rays [gap] (take).
acceptedAnswers: were broken / was examined / were taken

questions.prompt: She [gap] (keep) there for a night and she [gap] (give) permission to leave the next day.
acceptedAnswers: was kept / was given

questions.prompt: Ambulance services are also important. Patients [gap] (must / take) to hospital as quickly as possible.

questions.prompt: A lot of people [gap] (kill) in road accidents and a lot more [gap] (injure) but if more ambulances [gap] (put) into service, more lives [gap] (can / save).
acceptedAnswers: are killed / are injured|injured / are put / can be saved
are killed / are injured|injured / were put / could be saved

sections.instruction: Rewrite the following passage changing the suitable sentences into PASSIVE VOICE (rewrite each sentence below):
sections.contextText: Jane Johnson has been worried all last week. Last Monday, she received a letter from the police. In the letter they asked her to call the police station. Jane wondered why the police wanted her, and nothing worried her anymore. There, they told her that they had found her bike. They picked it up in a small village a week ago. Somebody stole it 10 years ago, when she was a girl of fifteen. Now, they are sending it to her.

questions.prompt: Last Monday, she received a letter from the police.
acceptedAnswers: Last Monday, she was sent a letter by the police.
Last Monday, a letter was sent to her by the police.
Last Monday, a letter from the police was received by her.

questions.prompt: In the letter they asked her to call the police station.
acceptedAnswers: In the letter she was asked to call the police station.

questions.prompt: Jane wondered why the police wanted her.
acceptedAnswers: Jane wondered why she was wanted by the police.
questions.explanation: past simple passive in a wh-clause

questions.prompt: There, they told her that they had found her bike.
acceptedAnswers: There, she was told that her bike had been found.

questions.prompt: They picked it up in a small village a week ago.
acceptedAnswers: It was picked up in a small village a week ago.

questions.prompt: Somebody stole it 10 years ago, when she was a girl of fifteen.
acceptedAnswers: It was stolen 10 years ago, when she was a girl of fifteen.

questions.prompt: Now, they are sending it to her.
acceptedAnswers: Now, it is being sent to her.
Now, she is being sent it.
